text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I are on our way back
to
campus after a day out, when
something seems to
hit her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's a place I'd like to stop by on our
way
back. Do you mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute leads the way for a while,
and
then... she just stops walking.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Now, where was it again?
choice_data_list: Uhm... where was it you wanted to drop by?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was around here somewhere,
but I
can't quite seem to remember.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember that cherry pie I
mentioned the
other day?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to get it out of my
head, so
I've been trying to find the
shop.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But, well... I just can't seem to pin it
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she's been looking for that bakery
she went to
when she was younger. I
wonder if there's any way
I can help...

Are you two lost or something? You've
just been
wandering around in circles.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Jordan. Hello there. I suppose we
are a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We tell Tosen Jordan about the shop
she's been
looking for.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why not use your phone? Just
search for
bakeries.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here, let's check this map app... Oh,
wow.
There's, like, a million bakeries
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember any details about the
place?
Like what color it was or what
kind of sign it had
or whatever?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Oh, I've got something. I
think it might
have had a red roof like
that store over there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Then, let's just snap a pic of that
roof and
do a quick image search...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a lovely picture! What was it
you said
you're going to do with it now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna upload it to this app, and it'll
find
similar pictures.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: See, look at all these red roofs it found.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What?! Wooow! I had no idea you could
do
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Smartphones are something else! I can't
believe
this little thing is so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! It's wild, right?! And this's
barely
scratching the surface! You can
find all the red
roofs in town, or...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You can take your picture, and... Check
it out!
Hilarious, right?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! That's incredible! My ears
are reindeer
antlers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone crash course continues
for a
while, with both student and
teacher seemingly
enjoying themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone crash course continues
for a
while, with both student and
teacher seemingly
enjoying themselves.

Looks like you had a good time.
Looks like you had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Me? With a smartphone?
choice_data_list: Why not take this chance to switch to a smartphone?
Looks like you had a good time.
Looks like you had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, I don't think so. I can still make
calls and
texts just fine with the one I've
got.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Flip phones are pretty amazing too, you
know.
Especially considering their size.
I'm perfectly
happy with mine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And your texts are so you, Acute. I just looove them. Whatever you do, don't change!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, I am. Smartphones are pretty

incredible.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And so is everyone who has one. They
know so
many different things.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I might have trouble getting the hang of
them,
but I'd love to learn more if I get a
chance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Say less! I'll make a smartphone master
out of you
yet!
